g.data-semantic-relation: encode each category ROI into shared multilayer features while retaining category coverage
g.data-must-show: 多個 product category 的 clean normal ROI | fixed backbone/selected feature maps | layer features | category ID 與 coverage 標籤
g.data-not-claim: 共享模型可忽略各類樣本數與正常模式。
